C-6.title: The reviewer authored an authority document the machine cannot consume
C-6.detail: d4a9e60 was written in the reviewer's narrative document style without first reading the consuming validator. The runtime requires exactly six top-level fields with pinned values, rejects an empty exact_surface outright, and requires the authority commit to be the direct child of its declared base. The narrative document failed all three, reproduced read-only by the operator as 'later epoch surface authorization shape drifted'. Same error class as C-5: a condition or artifact issued without checking the mechanism that must consume it.
C-6.rule_tightened: Any document destined for a machine gate must have its field set, pinned values, ordering rules and encoding read out of the consuming code first, and be checked against those exact predicates before commit. Narrative content goes in a companion document, never in the machine artifact.
